note: Wooded hills, fields and oxbow ponds along the Crooked River north of Richmond. Camping is allowed only at the seven parking lots marked with a camping symbol on the area map, each a small gravel lot: this one is at the bend of Dowdy Road at the west end, with others along Dowdy Road and Wildlife Road and one at the end of Maddux Road on the east side. No privy or water. Spot length is not published. --Claude
summary: Confirmed MDC 'Individual Campsites'; brochure: 'Primitive camping is permitted only in areas identified on area map', 14 days in 30. Free/FCFS/no hookups written manual. Map 8314map shows 7 numbered parking lots, each with a camping symbol; GIS has 8 camping points. Pin = GIS 236 / lot 1396 (map lot 1), a small gravel apron at the Dowdy Road bend; a 23-ft rig fits, no crossing on the way in. Split proposed for lot 4 at the end of Maddux Road. Not waterfront kept. Phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: the area page lists 'Camping: Individual Campsites'. Brochure (12/2025): 'Primitive camping is permitted only in areas identified on area map. Camping is limited to 14 consecutive days in a 30-day period.' The map marks a camping symbol beside each of parking lots 1-7. Imagery (leaf-off): the pin lot is a gravel apron ~20 m across where Dowdy Road bends and a lane runs south to lot 2; lot 4 is a gravel lot ~12 x 25 m at the end of Maddux Road. Both are enough for a 23-ft rig; no 4WD wording and no ford on Wildlife or Dowdy Road. The map's 'Impassable during high water' label is on Nolker Road / Fire Branch at the north edge, not on the way to any camping lot.

CLUSTERS (7 mapped lots over ~3.4 km): (1) pin, GIS 236/lot 1396, 39.4093,-94.0628, Dowdy Rd bend; (2) GIS 237/lot 1395, 39.4049,-94.0599, 550 m SE on the lane south of Dowdy Rd; (7, ADA) GIS 477/lot 2637, 39.4089,-94.0569, 520 m E on Dowdy Rd; (6) GIS 239/lot 1398, 39.4078,-94.0449, 1.55 km E at Wildlife Rd / W 176th St; (5) GIS 238/lot 1397, 39.3997,-94.0418, 2.1 km SE on Wildlife Rd; (3) GIS 241/lot 1400, 39.3864,-94.0394, 3.2 km SE on Wildlife Rd near the south boundary; (4) GIS 240/lot 1399, 39.3920,-94.0304, 3.4 km SE at the dead end of Maddux Road. GIS point 242/lot 1401 (39.4133,-94.0541) has no camping symbol on the map. Lots 1, 2, 3, 5, 6 and 7 all hang off Wildlife Road / Dowdy Road, the area's through roads, so no split for them.

SPLIT proposed (1): 'Crooked River Conservation Area - Maddux Road Camping Area' at 39.3921,-94.0304 (on lot 1399, gravel lot at the end of Maddux Road by Maddux Cemetery), state/MDC, same groups, phone 660-646-6122, not waterfront (small ponds only; Crooked River ~1.5 km W). Reached by Maddux Road from the east, its own road, 3.4 km from the pin lot.
PIN: stored 39.40926,-94.06282 = GIS camping point 236, on the gravel apron at the Dowdy Road bend. Fine.
